assumptions: seized collateral sold in one block at the reopen-regime sell curve
oracle tracks the gap fully at reopen; no partial recovery before reopen
isolated vault: collateral and debt are the vault totals (protocol API); debt valued at par
one aggregate position at the average LTV: individual positions nearer the threshold liquidate earlier; obligations not enumerated
close factor 0.2 and band 1 are inputs (band: Scope config not yet verified)
